text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted Dantsu Flame doing some high-intensity training.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hnngh, hnngh, mmggghhh—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Kh! No, no, no resting! One more rep—!
choice_data_list: You're really pushing yourself hard, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fueh!? Ah, umm...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's not like that... This is, well... just toning up... or rather, umm—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: U-Umm, m-may I ask you something? From your perspective, Trainer-san, do I, well...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Look... fat after all!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry so suddenly... The truth is, there's something that's been bothering me lately—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: My roommate, Mirako-senpai... before I know it, she's always squishing my cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Of course, it's not like I really hate it or anything, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ever since I was little, I've always been kind of roundish. Even when I work out, I stay squishy, and that's been a bit of a complex for me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I got to thinking, what if Mirako-senpai is indirectly telling me to lose weight... kh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, she didn't look overweight enough to worry at all. If she was still concerned, though—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: L-Like I said, Mirako-senpai, why do you poke and squish my cheeks?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I-Is it because... you're trying to tell me I should lose weight...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat~~~ No, no! That's not it at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: There's no deep meaning behind it! It's just—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: They're so smooth~ and so squishy~. And they even smell nice, kind of like flowers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Touching them calms me down~ and makes me forget bad things~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: They have outstanding healing power! Your cheeks, Dantsu-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hieeek. T-That's so embarrassing, Mirako-senpai~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So yeah, no bad intentions at all~. Sorry about that, I'll be careful from now on...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ............Umm, Mirako-senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: N-Not having you touch them all of a sudden feels kind of restless too, or something...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: R-Right?! I felt weird too!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well then, um, let's just keep things the way they've always been~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, but—I still do worry a bit about being roundish. So I think I'll keep up the muscle training anyway~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Dantsu Flame puff up with determination, I reminded her not to push herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, actually, there is a body cream I really love! Someone gave it to me as a present recently—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh~~, what's that! Now I'm curious too~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Then when we head back to our room, I'll put some on you too, Mirako-senpai. It's a special treat~ ...Just kidding!
